Do not redraw, relabel, enhance, reinterpret, add, or remove any part of the bottle. No new shadow, no backdrop, no checkerboard painted into pixels. assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Input: the sole photo is the exact edit target. Extract only this exact bottle from the promotional scene. Remove the dark background, rocks, floor and all foreground props. Make them genuinely transparent. Keep the actual photographed bottle, complete silhouette, wax cap, reflections and original label. Do not redesign or replace the bottle.
Critical correction from prior attempt: the printed bottom label text MUST remain exactly "DESONO / шардоне / белое сухое". Keep the large orange number "5000" and the original original pink-and-cream mountain landscape, winding white river, yellow field, small red sun. Preserve the original Russian typography, layout and soft fine print. Do not introduce Italian words, geographic origin claims, new brand names or the word "виноделие". Do not change the grape. Do not invent unreadable letters.
Output is an isolated product cutout with true alpha outside its silhouette. Preserve original dark green glass, ochre wax cap, colors, proportions and perspective. Remove all rocks from in front and behind. Keep the original bottle base shape with no rock residue. No shadow, backdrop, surface, white halo, recoloring, relighting, sharpening or unrelated new elements.
assets.review: Accepted after visual comparison at UI display size on a dark background. Main brand, product name, grape, year and type remain consistent where visible. Label layout and primary artwork match. Fine print, foil texture and reflections were resampled. This display derivative MUST NOT be used as source evidence for label microtext. Transparent alpha was verified. Attempt2 preserves the literal grape line from the source. All rocks and background props are removed. The bottle base has a generated completion where foreground rocks obscured the source.
